title: Shared Layout Transition for Toolbar Container
description: Implement a FLIP-based shared layout transition for the sketchpad toolbar container so switching tools/layers smoothly interpolates between previous and next bounds. Add a useSharedLayoutTransition hook and apply it to the toolbar zone elements.
summary: Enhanced toolbar FLIP transitions to work across app switching by caching the last measured bounding rect per toolbar zone key. Updated `useSharedLayoutTransition` to accept `sharedKey` and use a module-level rect cache as the 'First' measurement when the element remounts. Rewired hooks for tools/settings zones to use stable keys `semio.sketchpad.toolbar.zone.tools` and `semio.sketchpad.toolbar.zone.settings`.
